title: Guards
intro: Census phase: vanilla data, plus the Ehlnofey target band of each record. The guards: the hold guards, the Redoran guards, the other guard kinds and the unique guards, vanilla, DLC and CC. Every hold guard takes its level from the guard leaves of `LCharGuardImperial` or `LCharGuardSons`, which move to Experienced 30 with them (user, 2026-11-12), so every guard drawing them follows, the Imperial and Stormcloak garrison guards included. The soldier leaves stay Blooded.

sweep.title: Membership sweep (2026-10-02)
sweep.text: Every NPC in Skyrim, Update, Dawnguard, HearthFires, Dragonborn and the 74 CC packs that is in `GuardDialogueFaction` 02BE3B, `IsGuardFaction` 086EEE, `JobGuardCaptainFaction` 0813B7, a `GuardFaction*` (Cidhna Mine, Dawnstar, Dragon Bridge, Falkreath, Haafingar, Karthwasten, Kolskeggr, Markarth, Riften, Solitude, Soljund's, Whiterun, Windhelm), `DragonsreachBasementGuards` 065795 or `DLC2RavenRockGuardFaction` 0195AD:Dragonborn.esm; or whose EditorID or name marks a guard; or who wears a guard outfit; every `LVLN` named `LCharGuard*` or `DLC2LCharKolbjornGuard`; then every record that takes a template from one of them, every placed reference in every cell and worldspace, and every quest that names one. No plugin overrides a guard list. The College Guard `GuardWinterholdCollege` 105CBB is out of the census (2026-11-12): not placed, and no quest, list, script or CC plugin names it.
